name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and manages Nginx for three virtual hosts, including static content, per-site configuration, self-signed SSL certificates, and host security hardening.

name: cache
description: Installs and enables Memcached and Redis, configures Redis authentication and runtime paths, creates logging directories, and applies required configuration workarounds.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Installs Python and PostgreSQL prerequisites, deploys the FastAPI tutorial application with a virtual environment and dependencies, provisions its database, and runs it as a systemd service.
